housing.summary: Average rent for a 1-bedroom apartment in Norrköping city centre is approximately 6,684 SEK/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Deposit norm in Sweden is typically 1-3 months rent. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

banking.summary: Major Swedish banks operating in Norrköping include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. To open an account newcomers typically need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and in some cases proof of employment.
required_docs: Proof of employment or income (some banks)

schools.summary: Norrköping is in Östergötland County. International school options include IB-curriculum schools in the Linköping-Norrköping region. No dedicated standalone international school was directly verified within Norrköping city; IB options are available in the broader Östergötland region and Linköping. The Swedish school directory is at Skolverket.
curricula: IB (International Baccalaureate) available in broader Östergötland/Linköping region

legal_admin.summary: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months of arrival. This is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Registration is required to receive a personnummer and access to public services.

tax_finance.summary: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon completion of Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for banking, healthcare, employment, and tax matters in Sweden.

transport.summary: Public transport in Norrköping is operated by Östgötatrafiken (the regional transit authority for Östergötland County). Norrköping has a city tram and bus network. 30-day pass for the stadszon (city zone) costs 795 SEK (standard adult price, as of Aug 2026 per ostgotatrafiken.se). EU/EEA driving licences are valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency, then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Region Östergötland vårdcentral.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences remain valid in Sweden indefinitely. Non-EU licences valid for 1 year from registration; thereafter exchange required via Transportstyrelsen.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a Region Östergötland vårdcentral (primary care centre) at 1177.se
